CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Destroy trees without planting

2. Which response best shows understanding of : 1Peter Selected teachings ● Christian Suffering/ Persecution ● Good Stewards o? (1 mark)
   A. Use : 1Peter Selected teachings ● Christian Suffering/ Persecution ● Good Stewards o to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of : 1Peter Selected teachings ● Christian Suffering/ Persecution ● Good Stewards o with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing : 1Peter Selected teachings ● Christian Suffering/ Persecution ● Good Stewards o.
   D. Say : 1Peter Selected teachings ● Christian Suffering/ Persecution ● Good Stewards o has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem.
   B. Apply the teaching of Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem has no place in daily life.

4. Which response best shows understanding of : 1Peter Selected teachings? (1 mark)
   A. Say : 1Peter Selected teachings has no place in daily life.
   B. Use : 1Peter Selected teachings to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of : 1Peter Selected teachings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing : 1Peter Selected teachings.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Prophet Hosea? (1 mark)
   A. Use Prophet Hosea to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prophet Hosea.
   C. Apply the teaching of Prophet Hosea with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Prophet Hosea has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus Passion, Death and Resurrection? (1 mark)
   A. Use Jesus Passion, Death and Resurrection to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Jesus Passion, Death and Resurrection has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Jesus Passion, Death and Resurrection with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jesus Passion, Death and Resurrection.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Monarchy in Israel: King David? (1 mark)
   A. Say Monarchy in Israel: King David has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Monarchy in Israel: King David with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Monarchy in Israel: King David.
   D. Use Monarchy in Israel: King David to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Monarchy in Israel: King Solomon? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Monarchy in Israel: King Solomon.
   B. Use Monarchy in Israel: King Solomon to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Monarchy in Israel: King Solomon with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Monarchy in Israel: King Solomon has no place in daily life.

9. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

10. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

11. Which response best shows understanding of Schism and Syncretism in Israel? (1 mark)
   A. Say Schism and Syncretism in Israel has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Schism and Syncretism in Israel.
   C. Apply the teaching of Schism and Syncretism in Israel with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Schism and Syncretism in Israel to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Restoration of Judah: Nehemiah? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Restoration of Judah: Nehemiah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Restoration of Judah: Nehemiah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Restoration of Judah: Nehemiah.
   D. Say Restoration of Judah: Nehemiah has no place in daily life.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Schism and Syncretism in Israel and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Restoration of Judah: Nehemiah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Prophet Hosea and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

2. B — Apply the teaching of : 1Peter Selected teachings ● Christian Suffering/ Persecution ● Good Stewards o with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. B — Apply the teaching of Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. C — Apply the teaching of : 1Peter Selected teachings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. C — Apply the teaching of Prophet Hosea with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. C — Apply the teaching of Jesus Passion, Death and Resurrection with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. B — Apply the teaching of Monarchy in Israel: King David with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. C — Apply the teaching of Monarchy in Israel: King Solomon with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. D — Telling the truth and keeping trust

10. B — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

11. C — Apply the teaching of Schism and Syncretism in Israel with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. A — Apply the teaching of Restoration of Judah: Nehemiah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Schism and Syncretism in Israel; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Restoration of Judah: Nehemiah; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Prophet Hosea; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
